_note: External prerequisites for a fresh Resonance7 clone. Commands only - never put secrets here. Consumed by library/tools/scripts/setup.py. Python tools are stdlib-only, so there is intentionally no requirements.txt.

items.name: Node.js 18+
items.hint: Install Node 18+ from https://nodejs.org/ (or via a version manager), then re-run setup.py.

items.name: Freebuff CLI
items.hint: Optional if you already use Freebuff Desktop, Web, or the VS Code client. Opt-in install via --install-missing.
